answer: Proposal: weight identities by geographic dispersion. A meadow of independent landmark nodes sends signed probes; light-speed latency floors over copper and fiber pin every reply to a physical cell. The ledger caps reward per cell, shared by its identities, so N clones racked together split one cap and fresh keys are only new pigment on the same box. Spreading clones across real distant sites costs like honest scale-out; the defense holds while one cell's horizon reward stays below one extra site's cost. Limits: honest, scattered landmarks; a genuine global botnet is already dispersed.
